bricks.description: LIGHTING: controlled theatrical split lighting: a cool cyan-slate key grazing one side of the frame against a restrained deep magenta-amber rim separating shoulders and silhouette from dark shadows; crisp falloff without clipping skin highlights.
bricks.when: A night club, a dream, a duality.

bricks.description: LIGHTING: a single soft key from high to one side, leaving a small triangle of light on the shadow cheek, deep warm shadows and a dark background; painterly, quiet and sculptural.
bricks.when: A portrait with weight and dignity.

bricks.description: LIGHTING: the only light is a practical lamp in the scene, throwing a warm pool on the nearest surfaces and leaving the room around it in soft darkness; gentle falloff, no fill light.
bricks.when: Loneliness at night, a desk, a kitchen.

bricks.description: LIGHTING: hard overhead noon sunlight: short black shadows under every form, bleached highlights, saturated sky and heat; no soft fill, no golden glow.
bricks.when: Heat, a desert, a harsh truth.

bricks.description: LIGHTING: blue-hour ambient light after sunset: soft shadowless cool sky light, first warm windows and streetlights glowing, low contrast and a calm deep-blue cast.
bricks.when: An ending day, a quiet longing.
